note: Literature directly reports adult-onset SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy cases where structural cerebellar atrophy was found asymptomatically.

evidence.text: Two siblings with adult-onset proximo-distal and axial muscle weakness carrying biallelic SNUPN variants were described, in which brain MRI revealed asymptomatic cerebellar atrophy in one patient.

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: Two siblings carrying two novel deleterious variants in the SNUPN gene (p.Arg27Cys and p.Cys174Tyr) showed adult-onset proximo-distal and axial muscle weakness with early respiratory involvement. One patient presented with asymptomatic cerebellar atrophy.

numbers.metric: patients presenting with asymptomatic cerebellar atrophy

evidence.text: Pathogenic variants in SNUPN can cause cerebellar atrophy and spinocerebellar degeneration, expanding the phenotypic spectrum of SNUPN disorders across neuromuscular and central nervous systems.

source.title: SNUPN variants cause spinocerebellar atrophy by disrupting global splicing in cerebellar Purkinje cells
source.quote: These results expand the clinical spectrum of SNUPN-related disorders beyond skeletal muscle and highlight splicing dysregulation as a potential mechanism underlying cerebellar atrophy.
